a.xlink:title: Serializes ground canonical statements to CNF character codes (``p cnf`` header, ``c p weight`` lines when the problem is weighted, and clauses), assigning sequential variable numbers by first occurrence across clauses and weights. In a weighted problem, both literals of every variable get an explicit weight (1 when unspecified).
Serializes statements with origins and returns ``line(Start, End, Origin)`` source-map entries for the statements that generate lines (weight and probability statements do not).
Returns the ordered ``Term-Number`` variable table that the serialization predicates assign by first occurrence across clauses and weights.
True when the statements include a ``weight/2`` or ``probability/2`` statement.
